name: play_store_get_app_rating
intent: Get the star rating of an app in the Google Play Store
description: Dismiss the Google Play Store onboarding without signing in, search for the requested app, open its listing, and report the average star rating shown for that app without installing anything.
patterns: what is the star rating of this app
check an app rating in the Play Store
how many stars does this app have
find the app rating on Google Play

inputs.name: app_name
inputs.description: The app to look up in the Google Play Store.

steps.intent: Tap Skip to bypass the interests onboarding
Tap Continue to finish onboarding without signing in
Tap Not now to dismiss the offer prompt
Tap Got it to dismiss the onboarding tooltip
Tap Search to start searching the Play Store
Tap the search entry to open the search input
